# **I can easily file my GST returns using Swipe | Ramesh Kumar | shiv om engineering corporation**


## **Introduction**


Hello, I am Ramesh Kumar, and I belong to Shiv Om Engineering Corporation.


Our company is based in engineering, and daily, we have to deal with invoices, customer lists, payments, accounts, and everything related to GST.


It is crucial for every business to keep all the records in the best way possible as far as GST return filing is concerned.


## **How we managed billing earlier**


Initially, I managed my accounts and bookkeeping operations through QuickBooks.


It worked fine till QuickBooks decided to wind up its operations in India and made me search for new software to meet my business needs.


I wanted something user-friendly and capable of handling invoices, accounts and GST operations without adding to the complexity.


## **How i found Swipe**


In my search for something different, I discovered Swipe.


I had first noticed Swipe through an ad and thought it might be worth testing the software prior to moving all our business data to it.


I opted to start with the trial version of the software to get to know how it could benefit us.


After about a month’s worth of usage, I found it relatively simple and easy to deal with.


And that has assured me to proceed with shifting our data and making use of Swipe on an ongoing basis.


## **My experience with Swipe**


From the time i initiated the use of Swipe, I was pleasantly surprised by the efficiency with which tasks are carried out through the application.


Creating invoices and keeping track of your clients and business are all done easily.


The interface of the application is simple; hence, the learning curve is not high.


This helps us greatly in our daily operations, as we regularly deal with billing and accounting, and we want software that makes the process easy.


## **GST return filing with Swipe**


A highlight of the functionality for me is the GST feature.


Since Swipe keeps records of our bills and other transactions, the information necessary for making GST returns is kept in order.


This means that submitting GST returns is much less difficult.


I don’t need to gather details from various sources and invest more time in organising the information.


The necessary information is there, and a great amount of time is saved.


## **Easy to use**


Another thing I like about Swipe is that it is very user-friendly.


You don't necessarily have to be an accounting expert to understand the software.


Once you start using it, the invoicing and accounting process becomes quite straightforward.


This is especially useful for small and medium businesses where business owners themselves may be involved in billing and accounts.


## **Long-term experience with Swipe**


After trying Swipe and being satisfied with the software, I decided to continue using it for my business.


I also opted for a long-term plan, and we have now been using Swipe for around three and a half years.


During this period, it has become an important part of our regular billing and accounting process.


## **Overall experience**


Overall, my experience with Swipe has been very good.


It has made our invoicing simpler, helped us maintain our business records properly and, most importantly, made GST return filing much easier.


For me, having all this information available in one place saves a lot of time and makes managing the business more convenient.


## **Recommendation**


I would definitely recommend Swipe to other business owners who are looking for easy-to-use invoicing, accounting and GST software.


If you want a simple system where you can manage your invoices, business records and GST-related work without unnecessary complications, Swipe can be a very useful solution.
